title: 第8章 脸已经丢光了
slug: 修罗武帝全本免费-修罗武帝最新章节列表
content_zh:
姜辰苦笑着说道。
姜韵微微一笑，道：“是吗？那这样保持着，我就更高兴了。说不定哪天一激动，就原谅你了！”
“嗯，时间不早，我还需要教导族中弟子们修炼，这次从宗门回来的时间也不多了。你现在在哪里歇息？我迟点和姑姑联系上了，再去找你。”
“我没地方歇息，你在苍山寒潭边去找我吧，如果不出意外，我最近会一直在那里。”
“好。你拿了剑诀，就离开这里吧。眼下，姜家人大概是不喜欢你在这里的。”
“师姐你喜欢就好，别人，无所谓的。”
“又说昏话了！”
姜韵再次白了姜辰一眼，随即故意朝着姜辰挺了一下傲然，然后无比得意的转身离去。
姜辰无奈一笑，摇了摇头，随即轻轻一拍青玄剑，紫气如洪。
青玄剑一声清啸，姜辰飞上青玄剑，直接朝着荒山范围飞出，很快就离开了此地。
姜辰离开之后很久，远方，才显化出一个紫色纱裙身影。
“姜辰弟弟，你真的长大了。紫气境的境界，我竟然看之不透。而且紫气浩然，凝练如水，明显已经距离真元境一步之遥。三颗紫气丹，也可以完全巩固你的境界了。”
“不过，你是对姐姐的怜悯呢，还是姐姐真的令你心动呢？抑或者，仅仅只是少年年少气盛……”
姜韵静静的看着姜辰消失的身影，心情颇为复杂。
但，想到之前那拥抱，姜韵美丽的脸蛋儿上，又多出了一抹羞涩的红晕。
只不过，回想起来，她也才发现，姜辰故意搂抱自己的举动，顿时，姜韵又是好气又是好笑。
“这登徒子，开始就占了我便宜，我现在才知道！下回，一定得好好的防备着他！”
姜韵轻哼一声，随即又再次的笑了，接着便御剑离去。
大概也只有少女的心，才会如此之复杂吧。姜辰不知道，自己的举动已经被完全识破，因而被姜韵如防备色|狼一般的提防了。
若是知道，只怕是也哭笑不得了。

出了姜家的坟地范围之后，姜辰从荆棘之外降落而下。
他转了方向，直接进入镇中集市，用为数不多的真元魂石碎块，买了一坛酒后，便准备回到寒潭之地。
真元魂石，是这个世界的基础货币。
真元魂石里的能量可以被丹师提炼出来，配合药草，炼制成为真元丹。
而紫气丹，则是真元魂石碎块里的残存能量结合药草炼制而成的。
姜辰留下了一颗真元魂石的碎块，其余全部花掉，他准备在寒潭边参悟《天河剑诀》，同时也分析一下紫气丹的成分。
毕竟，姜辰有着医学的底蕴，对于医药的感知能力，自是也不会差。
再加上体内通了一百零八武脉穴位和正十二经奇经八脉任督二脉等一百零八穴位，他的资质悟性等等，也都妖孽到了极致。
姜辰不觉得这炼丹可以难到他。
不过，姜辰买了酒出来之后，却感觉到他被人跟踪了。
姜辰的灵魂气息凝聚，向着四方感应了出去，立刻便感应到一百余米之后的情况。
姜辰目光微微一亮，嘴角顿时浮起一缕笑意。
原本，他是朝着寒潭所在的地方行走的，但此时，他忽然停了下来，反而朝着那感应到的两个身影走去。
百余米的距离，很快到了。
大概是没有想到，姜辰会走回来，那两个身影也没有隐藏，因此一下子就被撞见了。
“姜峰啊，你的脸这就完全恢复了？莫不是吃了上好的丹药了？”
姜辰看着完好无损的姜峰，当即惊讶道。
至于他身边的红衣少女，姜辰自动忽略了。
“姜辰，你找死！”
姜峰脸色顿时无比难看，怒喝一声。

“峰哥，你不是说找姜辰有事吗？”
姜峰身边，红衣少女姜婷儿使了个眼色，轻轻的碰了一下姜峰的手臂，说道。
姜峰目光微微一闪，随即露出了一缕笑意，道：“嗯，之前吃过恢复丹药，倒是无碍了。姜韵说的对，我姜峰的确不该欺负弱小。不过听说你恢复了，你妹妹傍上了万雪宫的天才古昊，想来你以后也要发达了。”
姜辰闻言，双眼微微眯起，道：“好说好说，发达了，肯定不会忘记姜韵等对我好的人的好处的。”
姜峰笑了笑，一缕不屑之意一闪即逝。
随即，他很好的隐藏了这份不屑，反而认真说道：“对了，你的事情，家族也有所听说，所以族长让我交代你一些事情。不过，这里不是说话的地方，你随我来吧。”

content_en:
Jiang Chen said with a wry smile.
Jiang Yun smiled slightly and said: "Really? If you keep it like this, I will be even happier. Maybe one day I will be excited and forgive you!"
"Well, it's getting late. I still need to teach the disciples in the clan how to practice. I don't have much time to come back from the sect this time. Where are you resting now? I will contact my aunt later and then look for you."
"I have no place to rest. You can go find me by the cold pond in Cangshan Mountain. If nothing else happens, I will be there all the time."
"Okay. After you take the sword technique, leave here. Right now, the Jiang family probably doesn't like you here."
"Senior Sister, as long as you like it, it doesn't matter to others."
"You're talking nonsense again!"
Jiang Yun rolled her eyes at Jiang Chen again, then deliberately looked proudly at Jiang Chen, then turned and left with great pride.
Jiang Chen smiled helplessly, shook his head, and then lightly patted the Qingxuan Sword, and the purple energy was like a flood.
The Qingxuan Sword roared loudly, and Jiang Chen flew onto the Qingxuan Sword, flew directly towards the barren mountain range, and soon left the place.
Long after Jiang Chen left, a figure in a purple gauze dress appeared in the distance.
"Brother Jiang Chen, you have really grown up. I can't see through the state of the Purple Qi Realm. Moreover, the Purple Qi is vast and condensed like water, and it is obviously one step away from the True Yuan Realm. Three Purple Qi Pills can completely consolidate your state."
"But do you feel pity for your sister, or does she really make your heart move? Or is it just that you are a young and energetic person..."
Jiang Yun looked at Jiang Chen's disappearing figure quietly, feeling quite complicated.
However, thinking of the hug before, a shy blush appeared on Jiang Yun's beautiful face.
However, in retrospect, she also realized that Jiang Chen deliberately hugged her, and Jiang Yun was immediately angry and funny at the same time.
"This scoundrel took advantage of me from the beginning, and I only know it now! Next time, I must be careful about him!"
Jiang Yun snorted, then smiled again, and then left with her sword.
Probably only a girl's heart can be so complicated. Jiang Chen didn't know that his actions had been completely seen through, so Jiang Yun was as wary as a pervert.
If he knew it, he would probably not know whether to laugh or cry.
After leaving the Jiang family cemetery, Jiang Chen descended from beyond the thorns.
He changed direction and went directly to the market in the town. He used the few fragments of the True Essence Soul Stone to buy a jar of wine, and then prepared to return to the Cold Pond.
True Soul Stone is the basic currency of this world.
The energy in the True Essence Soul Stone can be extracted by the alchemist, combined with herbs, and refined into the True Essence Pill.
The Purple Qi Pill is made from the remaining energy in the fragments of the True Essence Soul Stone combined with medicinal herbs.
Jiang Chen left a fragment of the True Essence Soul Stone and spent the rest. He planned to study the "Tianhe Sword Art" by the cold pool and also analyze the components of the Purple Qi Pill.
After all, Jiang Chen has a background in medicine, and his ability to perceive medicine is not bad.
In addition, his body is connected to 108 acupuncture points of the Martial Meridian and 108 acupoints including the 12 regular meridians, the 8 extraordinary meridians, and the 2 Rendu meridians. His qualifications, understanding, etc. are also extremely evil.
Jiang Chen didn't think that making alchemy would be difficult for him.
However, after Jiang Chen bought wine and came out, he felt that he was being followed.
Jiang Chen's soul aura condensed and was sensed in all directions, and he immediately sensed the situation more than a hundred meters away.
Jiang Chen's eyes brightened slightly, and a smile suddenly appeared at the corner of his mouth.
Originally, he was walking towards the place where Hantan was, but at this moment, he suddenly stopped and walked towards the two figures he sensed.
The distance of more than a hundred meters was quickly reached.
He probably didn't expect that Jiang Chen would come back, and the two figures didn't hide, so they were caught immediately.
"Jiang Feng, your face is completelyRecovered? Could it be that he took a good elixir? "
Jiang Chen looked at the intact Jiang Feng and immediately said in surprise.
As for the girl in red beside him, Jiang Chen automatically ignored it.
"Jiang Chen, you are looking for death! "
Jiang Feng's face suddenly turned extremely ugly and he shouted angrily.
"Brother Feng, didn't you say you had something to do with Jiang Chen? "
Next to Jiang Feng, the girl in red, Jiang Ting'er, winked, gently touched Jiang Feng's arm and said.
Jiang Feng's eyes flashed slightly, and then he showed a smile and said: "Well, I took the recovery pill before, so it's fine. Jiang Yun is right, I, Jiang Feng, really shouldn't bully the weak. But I heard that you have recovered, and your sister is dating Gu Hao, the genius of Wanxue Palace. I think you will also become rich in the future. "
Hearing this, Jiang Chen narrowed his eyes slightly and said, "It's easy to talk, and when I get rich, I will definitely not forget the benefits of Jiang Yun and other people who are good to me. "
Jiang Feng smiled, a hint of disdain disappearing in a flash.
Immediately, he hid his disdain well and said seriously: "By the way, the family has heard about your affairs, so the patriarch asked me to tell you something. However, this is not the place to talk, just come with me. "
